Before any production-source mutation, the executor must verify the accepted D07 decision is linked from the authoritative record; if the prior OPEN D07 state remains current, stop as AUTHORITY\_CONFLICT.

## Repository identity and execution anchor

- Repository: Mostorm-Labs/axiom
- Trusted feature baseline: branch codex/selection-summary-batch3, SHA c7f874395d55952e9d5288e2a336a21747f37f11
- Audit worktree/branch: codex/fc04-d07-selection-audit
- Reported audit result commit: e02fb7b8601bd01be968dbfb6aa783cfb3027e25
- Local report: C:/Users/Chado/.codex/worktrees/selection-unified-batch1/canvas/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AUDIT/[report.md](http://report.md)
- Local commands: C:/Users/Chado/.codex/worktrees/selection-unified-batch1/canvas/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AUDIT/commands.json

These local paths and commit are supplied by the execution owner and were not independently fetchable from the connected remote GitHub surface in this review. The executor must verify repository identity, branch, HEAD, clean/dirty state, and report/commands contents before edits. Do not assume that the worktree is at the reported commit just because the path exists.

## Objective

Repair only the three D07 audit failures:

1. cross-Operation intent coordination;
2. one user-visible Undo unit per successful multi-Operation user intent;
3. post-commit memory-allocation failure containment.

Preserve all existing Selection Batch 1–3 work.

## Accepted bounded behavior

One user-visible intent spanning multiple canonical Operations must either:

- commit as one coherent local Runtime/Scene result and create exactly one user-visible Undo unit; or
- fail before canonical mutation and create no successful History item.

Required: preflight all forward Operations; prepare exact inverse/preimage/expectations; reserve HistoryGroup/UndoIntent and all necessary result/publication memory before mutation; serialize local commit/publication; preserve ordinary typed Operations and their identities/semantic validation; exact-target Undo; fresh-identity Redo; failure leaves Document, Scene/index publication, History cursor and redo branch unchanged.

Scope excludes crash-atomic persistence, cross-client atomic visibility, distributed transactions, and a canonical global Transaction.

## Step 0 — Required exact-subject preflight

1. Verify repository identity is Mostorm-Labs/axiom and inspect current branch/HEAD.
2. Verify the reported task anchor is the trusted Selection baseline and reconcile ancestry to the current audit worktree.
3. Read [report.md](http://report.md) and commands.json from the exact local audit result. Copy the exact three failing test IDs, test targets, commands, exit codes, and failure evidence into the materialized package before mutation.
4. Confirm the 160 Selection regression suite and 11 passing D07 tests are preserved.
5. Confirm the D07 accepted scope is linked from the authoritative D07 record. If the current authoritative record still marks D07 OPEN without this accepted scope, stop before production source changes and return AUTHORITY\_CONFLICT.
6. Inspect the three failure implementations and exact test bodies; do not infer failure IDs from this package summary.

## Allowed implementation scope

Only source/test files required to fix the three named D07 failures:

- existing local multi-Operation intent coordinator / IntentPlan / IntentCommitSegment / UndoIntent / HistoryGroup implementation, as discovered on the verified worktree;
- EditorHistory and its existing submit/undoable command owner, if directly implicated;
- the minimum local commit/publication or result-reservation owner if directly implicated by the post-commit memory failure;
- focused D07 tests and fault-injection tests in the existing runtime/interaction test area.

The executor must record the exact paths before editing. If a fix appears to require files outside these ownership areas, stop and classify the blocker instead of widening scope.

## Forbidden changes

- Do not alter Selection Batch 1–3 behavior except to keep its regression suite green.
- Do not change D06-B partial-applicability policy or begin multi-selection property editing.
- Do not add a global canonical Transaction, generic arbitrary operation-list wire semantics, new ObjectKind, FieldId, PropertyValue, OperationKind, public ABI, global registry, or schema change.
- Do not add crash/cross-client atomicity requirements.
- Do not weaken, delete, skip or relabel existing tests.
- Do not modify accepted oracle/fixtures or historical audit results.
- Do not merge to main automatically.

## EXECUTION\_CLOSURE\_CONTRACT

### implementation.required\_changes

- Fix the exact three failing D07 audit areas within the allowed owner scope.
- Ensure all forward operations and target preconditions are validated before the first canonical mutation.
- Prepare inverse/preimage/expectation data and reserve HistoryGroup/UndoIntent plus required result/publication memory before mutation.
- Ensure success produces one user-visible Undo unit and Redo restores the forward intent with fresh operation identities.
- Ensure failure does not expose partial local Scene/observer publication and leaves the accepted state invariants intact.
- Preserve all existing Selection Batch 1–3 implementation.

### implementation.forbidden\_changes

- All items listed under Forbidden changes above.

### tests.required

- Exact original three failed D07 tests from [report.md/commands.json](http://report.md/commands.json): all PASS without changing their intended assertions.
- All 11 original passing D07 checks: remain PASS.
- All 160 Selection regression tests: remain PASS.
- Failure injection at every forward Operation and History/result reservation boundary.
- Multi-operation success: exactly one visible Undo unit.
- Undo after changing current selection: restores original committed targets.
- Redo: correct forward meaning and fresh identities.
- Failure: Document snapshot, Scene/index publication, History cursor, redo branch and observer-visible state match the accepted local atomicity contract.
- Post-commit allocation failure: no canonical mutation can be stranded without its History unit; reserve required allocations before mutation or contain failures inside the serialized commit boundary.

### tests.command\_or\_oracle

Use exact commands from the verified commands.json for the original 14 D07 checks and the 160 Selection regressions. Add exact commands for new fault-injection tests. Record command, exit code, raw stdout/stderr, test target, environment and resulting revision. Do not invent or substitute commands without recording the reason.

### hosted\_verification.required

- Repository CI applicable to the exact repair revision, if the project runs it for this branch/PR.
- No physical-device verification is required for this D07-only repair unless a failure mode crosses the platform boundary; if that occurs, stop and reclassify scope.

### evidence.blocking

- Exact preflight identity report.
- Exact mapping of the three original failures to source/test owners.
- Raw test outputs and exit codes for all required tests.
- Fault-injection evidence for memory/history reservation and commit failure.
- Before/after Document, Scene publication, History cursor and redo branch assertions.
- Exact source revision, diff, hashes and terminal result.

### evidence.corroborative

- Existing 11 passing D07 tests.
- Existing 160 Selection regression results.
- Source review notes and non-blocking diagnostics.

### terminal\_success.all\_of

- D07 accepted scope is confirmed in the authoritative record.
- The three original failures pass with unchanged intent.
- The 11 existing D07 passes and 160 Selection regression passes remain green.
- New fault-injection tests prove the accepted local failure-containment guarantees.
- Successful multi-operation intent creates exactly one user-visible Undo unit; Undo/Redo target the original intent.
- No forbidden scope changes are present.
- Exact result and evidence are independently reviewable.

### terminal\_blockers.explicit\_classes

- AUTHORITY\_CONFLICT
- MISSING\_REQUIRED\_INPUT
- ENVIRONMENT\_BLOCKER
- FROZEN\_VERIFICATION\_FAILURE
- NEW\_HIGH\_IMPACT\_FAILURE\_MODE
- TASK\_PACKAGE\_DEFECT
- EXECUTION\_DIVERGENCE

### return\_policy

continue\_until\_terminal\_state: true

## Terminal result

Return exact base/HEAD, branch, actual source/test paths changed, original three test IDs, commands/exit codes/raw results, all regression counts as owned by their test artifacts, failure-injection evidence, diff summary, hashes, and unresolved items. Do not claim D07 PASS unless all terminal-success conditions hold. D06-B remains separate and OPEN.

## Control update after package creation (2026-10-27)

The bounded D07 decision has now been appended to the FC-00X-C record as a targeted accepted-scope supersession. See [FC-00X-C Capability Resolution Contract](https://app.notion.com/p/3f94c57a590c81b8ad8ceb2239759cba), section “P23 Targeted D07 Decision — Accepted Scope Supersession”.

The remaining execution preflight is local: verify the actual audit worktree and bind the exact three failing D07 test IDs, commands, targets, and raw outputs from [report.md/commands.json](http://report.md/commands.json) before any source edit. If these inputs are missing or disagree with the supplied baseline, stop rather than guessing.
